config.notes: Primary mandate from USER_DIRECTIVES.md: design a read-only zero-ETL MongoDB-backed FHIR server source parallel to the HAPI PostgreSQL integration, targeting Mongo-backed servers such as icanbwell/fhir-server / Helix FHIR Server. Start with feature_design because no pre-approved implementation plan exists. Design must prove current-resource/deleted-resource collection semantics before hardcoding schema assumptions, preserve the standard resources view contract (id, resourceType, resource, patient_ref), use DuckDB's community mongo extension for analytical reads, and include a Docker development/smoke stack plus docs and website updates. Security focus: quote identifiers and SQL literals separately, avoid leaking Mongo credentials, and cover malicious URI/database/collection/patient-reference inputs. Release Engineer artifact gate is required before final completion because the likely work may affect optional dependencies, Docker image contents/workflows, public exports, docs navigation, release artifacts, and DuckDB extension behavior. Discovery: pyproject.toml reports target package version 0.0.7; git status checks are slow in this workspace, so design should inspect relevant source-adapter and Docker/doc directories directly.
